## Design

### 2026-10-07 – Today I worked on my Smart Disaster Safety System project. I planned how the sensors, microcontroller, buzzer, warning lights, and display will work together. I researched how gas and vibration sensor

**4h**

Today I worked on my Smart Disaster Safety System project. I planned how the sensors, microcontroller, buzzer, warning lights, and display will work together. I researched how gas and vibration sensors can detect dangerous situations and how the system can give an early warning. I also worked on the circuit design and thought about how I can improve the project in the future. I learned more about connecting sensors to a microcontroller and using programming to trigger alerts when a sensor reading passes a certain level.

i have done the pcb of my project Hack Club is a community where students can learn programming, electronics, hardware, and technology by actually building projects. Instead of only learning from textbooks, Hack Club encourages students to experiment, create, and solve real-world problems.

One thing I really like about Hack Club is that it gives students the opportunity to turn their ideas into real projects. We can build things using technologies like Arduino, sensors, microcontrollers, and programming.

For example, I am interested in building a Smart Disaster Safety System. This project can use sensors to detect things such as harmful gases or unusual vibrations. When a dangerous condition is detected, the system can give an alert using a buzzer, warning lights, or a display.

Hack Club also helps students develop important skills such as problem-solving, creativity, teamwork, coding, electronics, and engineering.

My goal is to keep learning, build better hardware projects, and eventually create technology that can help people in real life.

Hack Club shows us that we don't have to wait until we are adults to build something amazing. We can start creating today.
